formal: I began taking a new blood pressure tablet one month ago, and it causes me to feel slightly dizzy when I stand up. My next appointment is in six weeks. The plan is for me to cut the tablets in half myself until that appointment. I have been in the habit of running health questions of this kind past you first, and have done so for years. I am unable to determine whether the dizziness matters more than taking the full dose, so I will go along with the plan without making a decision of my own. What is your view?
